git_note: Nothing in this tranche is committed. Evidence is tied to HEAD plus a dirty marker and the SHA-256 file hashes stored in every run artifact, not to a clean commit.
objective: TRI-19 P0: replace the public-certificate replay with a from-scratch, deterministic, dual-verified baseline for AlphaEvolve Problem 59 and record one 64-trial reproduction gate

runs.qualification: Systems smoke test of the Python swarm on a small grid; not a competitive baseline.
Replay only: this run was initialized from the public 58-point certificate, so its best_score of 58 is not a from-scratch reproduction and not a discovery.

The Modal sandbox ran a copy of the same per-apex distance algorithm as the controller, so its agreement was one algorithm agreeing with itself, not independent verification. Its provider cost was not recorded.

implementation.interpreter: Python 3.12.13 from .venv (no bare python on PATH; pyproject targets 3.11)

checks.outcome: byte-identical; score 56 at this shorter budget

implementation.post_gate_verification: All 64 child artifacts were reloaded from disk in a fresh process: required fields present in every child, both local oracles and the pinned upstream verify_construction accept every candidate, 0 disagreements, 0 failure artifacts, score counts equal the parent, seed 4 replayed to byte-identical stdout, no secret-like strings or provider response bodies, the 3 earlier run artifacts untouched.

checks: manifest validation and dual-oracle benchmark verification passed independently
all 64 child artifacts were reparsed and reverified by both local oracles and the pinned upstream verifier
parent artifact SHA-256 matches the session summary
primary_agent_audit.disposition: P0 reproduction evidence accepted with the unartifacted calibration history retained as a limitation

result.from_scratch_58_note: Up to the 8 symmetries of the square, the 10 from-scratch 58-point sets are images of the two sets already published in upstream issue 10: seeds 4, 5, 22 give set_a (the stored certificate) and seeds 10, 18, 29, 41, 44, 53, 61 give set_b. This is a reproduction, not a discovery.
result.cross_agent_memory_observed: earlier claim withdrawn as evidence: the swarm sets inherited_from_agent whenever another agent has an equal-or-better entry, so it was true by construction
result.modal_sandbox_agreed_with_trusted_verifi: earlier claim qualified: same-algorithm agreement only, not independent verification

cost_note: The P0 tranche made no provider calls. The earlier Modal smoke run's cost was never recorded and is not included.
blockers: No commit exists for this work, so no clean Git SHA can be cited; committing was not authorized in this tranche.
The solver parameters (20% noise, tabu 3 plus rand 10) and the 1000000-iteration budget were calibrated on off-gate seeds 1000..1015; those calibration runs were not saved as artifacts.
The public method's source and budget are not pinned, so solver/solver.c is an independent implementation and the 10 of 64 rate is not budget-matched to the public 15 of 200.
The mirror-symmetric baseline only reaches even cardinalities; it cannot output 59 until a symmetry-breaking operator exists.
The public point list comes from a mutable GitHub issue; only its retrieved content hash is pinned. The second public 58-point set is not stored under benchmarks/.
The older swarm path is unchanged: it still seeds from the public certificate, hardcodes TRI-18 in its artifacts, and uses same-algorithm sandbox verification.
.github/workflows/ci.yml still expects validate to fail and has no C compiler step for the new solver test beyond the runner default; it was not edited.
Exa, past.dev and Modal remain untested and were not called.
next_decision: Decide whether to commit this tranche so later evidence can cite a clean SHA. Then choose one bounded P1 step: a symmetry-breaking destroy/repair operator started from from-scratch 58-point sets, preregistered on fresh seeds (not 0..63) with a fixed iteration budget, compared against this baseline as an exploratory two-arm run. No 59-point search has been started.
